### Love the Whole World, One Person at a Time (Acts 4:32) - Your Daily Bible Verse - May 23
Author: Becca Stevens
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/love-the-whole-world-one-person-at-a-time-bible-study-minute-may-23-2018.html
Passage: Acts 4:32
Points:
- Christian generosity grows out of recognizing God's immense grace and blessings in our own lives.
- The early believers took Christ's command to love their neighbors seriously by sharing all their possessions.
- Resting in the abiding love of Jesus dispels fear and fosters radical generosity.
- Discipleship involves loving the world through daily interactions, lifestyle choices, and small everyday kindnesses.

### Bible Pathways 11/10/04
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-11-or-10-or-04-1293996.html
Passage: Acts 4:32-37
Points:
- The earliest church displayed deep unity of heart and soul, sharing resources so no one lacked necessities.
- Members who owned property sold it voluntarily to support needy brothers and sisters in Christ.
- Biblical stewardship recognizes that God is the rightful owner of all things, and believers are merely His managers.
- Faithful and sincere giving reflects genuine devotion to God and mutual care within the community.
